what_it_is: Top-loading pedicle screw system for complex spinal deformity correction. Accepts 5.5 mm and 6.0 mm diameter titanium and cobalt chrome rods. Mixed-metal (Ti/CoCr) tulip minimizes head splay with improved biomechanical performance vs all-titanium screws. Dual-lead thread pattern for faster insertion. Tapered distal third for increased pullout strength.
sizing_specs: Accepts 5.5 mm and 6.0 mm rods. Titanium and cobalt chrome rod options. Multiple screw types available.
compatible_with: BaseCamp deformity rod reducer for sequential reduction and correction. Compatible with Spine Guidance 5 and Mako Spine with Copilot features.
use_notes: Modified square thread set screw design facilitates introduction. BaseCamp allows placement of multiple tubes for sequential reduction. Now sold by VB Spine.
